app.title: bklv capability overview
app.subtitle: Sidebar switches pages · arrows move focus · Enter activates

demo.desc: Layout by Yoga, drawing by ImGui's ImDrawList; the view layer never touches a graphics API.

json.hint: This page comes from resources/views/*.json: attribute tables are per-class static, values accept native types and "12px" / "50%" / "@i18n/" / "@style/" / "@theme/" / "@res/" prefixes. List items are the same idea, with values supplied by a binder.
json.list_section: List item template from JSON + data binding
json.load_failed: JSON failed to load, see the log window
json.card_desc: Text, spacing, radius and colors all live in JSON; copy changes need no rebuild.
json.row_subtitle: fields title / subtitle / thumb come from a C++ binder

theme.hint: Appearance comes from resources/theme/<name>/widgets/*.json: draw structure (background/border/text) and state animation (tweeny interpolation) all live in JSON. Copy default, rename, edit JSON - that is a new skin.
theme.widgets_desc: Rectangle and Button contain no drawing code at all - background, radius, text and colors all come from JSON.
theme.states_desc: Move focus with left/right, watch the color tween; press A to see the press feedback.
theme.bottom_hint: The bottom bar is appearance-driven too: top line + one line of text, structure in widgets/bottom_bar.json
theme.dialog_desc: Backdrop and panel are appearance-driven: opacity and offset tweens live in JSON. While open, input is modal - clicks outside and arrow keys do not reach the page below, and focus returns to the button that opened it.
theme.dialog_demo_text: Panel, title, body and button placement all come from theme JSON. Try clicking outside: it will not pass through.
theme.dropdown_desc: Opens as an overlay: the list is anchored right below the trigger, input becomes modal, and it closes on outside click or selection. Option appearance (selected/focused colors) is in JSON too.
theme.input_desc: Desktop uses inline typing (characters / backspace / arrows / Enter to accept / Esc to cancel); Switch pops the system keyboard (swkbd). Editing is a standalone text model, so CJK is deleted by character.

nav.hint: TabFrame and Sidebar are library-level widgets: tab cells, selected state and panel colors are all described by theme JSON. Switching tabs detaches the old page instead of destroying it.
nav.body_a: Switch away and back - this page is not rebuilt.
nav.body_b: Page content is provided by the caller; TabFrame only handles switching and appearance.
nav.body_c: Sidebar items share the same cell appearance as tabs (widgets/tab_cell.json).

applet.hint: AppletFrame is the app shell: header + content stack + bottom bar. Press 'push' to drill in, Enter/B to go back level by level; content is detached, not destroyed, so its state survives.
applet.title: Settings
applet.subtitle: AppletFrame demo
applet.level_hint: This is level {} content. The bottom bar shows the focused action's hints.
